name: Descript
summary: AI video and audio editor where you edit a recording by editing its transcript.
description: Desktop video and audio editor built on text-based editing: delete a word in the auto-transcript and it is cut from the footage. Includes the Underlord AI co-editor, transcription in 23+ languages, screen recording, captions, AI clips, avatars, Studio Sound and Eye Contact, plus Rooms for 4K remote recording; templates bundle these into guided workflows. Translation and dubbing cover 30+ languages, and a free plan leads to paid plans from $16/month.
